doc.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007

title: Upcoming projects with Toninho Horta
summary: He plans a duet album with Toninho Horta and a Maraca Valle tune, and is teaching privately.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: To get to the solo. I concur. What’s coming up in the near future for you?

Well I just got together with Toninho Horta just before I came up here and we’re planning a duet album and we are putting that together right now. And then I have, again it’s been a year since the last album came out so I’ve been compiling material. I have some sessions planned but not specifically dated. And I’m going to do the material that I’ve been accumulating. There’s Maraca Valle, “Land of Maraca Valle,” a Cuban flautist, I’m writing lyrics to his tune and I’m going to record that. Actually the lyrics are done. And another Toninho Horta composition that we’re going to record both on the album with him and another album that I’m going to record. So I’m in the throes of trying to put together another album, and teaching privately. Gigs — you got any?
They come and they go. I got one for you tonight.
You provided this it was a lot of fun and I thank you, right on camera for that. Thank you very much.
